usedFor: Shopify holds the catalog and Contentful holds the content, so “New Product” can feed “Create Entry”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Create Entry” in Contentful
bestTemplate.why: Each new product gets an entry in Contentful, ready for “Publish Entry” when the copy is done.

watchOut: “Publish Entry” makes an entry available to the Content Delivery API, so publish only finished content.
